svg.title: SupportAI chat widget demo
svg.desc: Animated illustration. A shopper asks about returning worn boots and gets a grounded answer. They then ask for a card refund, which the bot hands to a human by collecting their email and creating a ticket. A side panel lights up each server-side step.
